# codigate_workspace_alerts (Resource)

Extra channels for the workspace's origin health alerts: a signed webhook and an ntfy topic. Email to the admins needs no setup. One per workspace; destroying it turns both channels off. Adding a channel needs the Starter plan or higher; removing one works on every plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "alert_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "ntfy_topic_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "codigate_workspace_alerts" "this" {
  webhook_url = var.alert_webhook_url # e.g. https://hooks.example.com/codigate
  ntfy_url    = var.ntfy_topic_url    # e.g. https://ntfy.sh/acme-alerts
}

# Verify the X-Codigate-Signature header on your webhook receiver with this secret.
output "alert_signing_secret" {
  value     = codigate_workspace_alerts.this.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ntfy_url` (String, Sensitive) ntfy topic URL, for example https://ntfy.sh/<topic>. https:// only, at most 2000 characters; the host must be public. Leave out for no ntfy alerts.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook that receives each alert as JSON, signed like log export (X-Codigate-Signature header). https:// only, at most 2000 characters; the host must be public. Leave out for no webhook.

### Read-Only

- `allowed` (Boolean) Whether the workspace's plan allows webhook and ntfy alerts.
- `has_secret` (Boolean) Whether the workspace has a webhook signing secret.
- `id` (String) Always "workspace".
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret that signs each webhook request. Only known when Terraform added the webhook (the API returns it once); null after an import. It stays the same when the webhook URL changes and is removed with the webhook.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import codigate_workspace_alerts.this workspace
```
